turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty-five minutes, Hale. My son found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided, and on what basis?
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Don't manage me, Hale. I asked you who decided and on what basis, and I'm still waiting for the answer.
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
You want me to tell you how to do your job? Take the zero off, Hale, and tell me who put it there.
I just want us to be on the same team here.
Then why are we here, Hale? Teams don't enter a zero first and call the parent never.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero on Owen's essay be withdrawn, an apology, and an answer to who decided on it and on what basis. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, with nothing agreed.
What moved her: nothing.
